name: 2C-CP
summary: 2C-CP, or 2C-cP, also known as 4-cyclopropyl-2,5-dimethoxyphenethylamine, is a psychedelic and designer drug of the phenethylamine and 2C families. It was first synthesized by Daniel Trachsel and colleagues in 2006 and was subsequently described by them in the literature in 2013.
